_help: FQBN = Fully Qualified Board Name. Copy the FQBN column from: arduino-cli board listall
Filter in PowerShell: arduino-cli board listall | Select-String 'pico'
Installed core packages: arduino-cli core list
Connected boards and COM ports: arduino-cli board list
Add entries as: profile_name: FQBN. The COM port is selected separately. This _help section is ignored by the uploader.
